lines.trans: You are a department director at least; stop trying to smooth both sides over.
Xingtian's talent-management unit has never gotten off the ground.
Xingzi alone holds plenty of artist contacts in her hands.
Assistant Qin, what we said tonight will not hurt ties with the network, right?
I am simply a student fresh out of college.
Listening to everyone chat after work is very helpful to me.
In fact, without everyone's support, Xingtian would not work so well with the network.
Assistant Qin, this lounge is our favourite spot to vent.
You will get used to it before long.
Whenever something bothers you, come chat with us after work.
